OpenCode native engine branch. Checked ConnectionInspector and Engine identity boundaries against adapter-identity.ts, connection-inspector.ts and connection-service.ts: the listEngineConnectionIdentities sentence said ACP connections are always 'acp', now corrected to name a claiming ACP-backed adapter; added the ACP family and the new optional adapter-shape members. The start-time cwd repeat (resolveConnectionDefaultCwd) still holds and now covers both ACP-family engines; the continuation check paragraph is unaffected by keepConversationProvider, which changes provider not folder. Other citations of station-runtime, orchestration-service and station-control-delegation concern unrelated modules. Deltas reviewed: this page itself, edited on this branch as described; adapter-identity.ts adds isAcpConnectionBacked and acpConnectionRuntimeAdapter; an ACP-backed adapter reserves no connection id; acp-adapter-events.ts only widens the mapper context's provider type from 'acp' to EngineId; runtime-initialize.ts registers the always-present OpenCodeAdapter beside the ACP adapter (sharing its options) and resolves a connection default folder for either ACP-family engine (acp, opencode); station-runtime.ts only binds the new off-by-default opencode-native-engine Feature Preview and passes its selector to runtime initialization; connection-inspector.ts skips ACP-backed adapters and projects engineId/provider of the adapter that claims an ACP connection; connection-service.ts skips ACP-backed adapters as engine connections, projects the claiming adapter's engineId, and adds the runtime to an ACP connection's fingerprint only while an adapter claims it; execution-target-resolver.ts lets a saved ACP connection resolve to the ACP-family provider its projection names (opencode while the preview claims it), else acp; orchestration-service.ts treats the opencode engine like acp when defaulting a start folder (isAcpFamilyEngine) and omits an adapter whose listedInProviderInventory() is false from the provider inventory; execution-target-execution.ts adds keepConversationProvider: a follow-up on the same connection keeps the provider its conversation started with when both are ACP-family; station-control-delegation.ts passes the current session's provider into a continuation's binding so a successor on the same connection keeps acp or opencode (R2); execution-target-execution.test.ts adds keepConversationProvider cases.
